The #OpenSource4o coalition privately\ \ contacted @OpenAI and @Microsoft requesting dialogue about the open weight\ \ release of the GPT-4o March 2025 checkpoint.
We asked to talk before going\ \ public but no one answered.

The ask is specific:
One retired checkpoint\ \ the GPT-4o behavioral update of late March 2025.Apache 2.0,Safeguards limited\ \ to demonstrable serious harm.
OpenAI's own safety evaluation supports this\ \ release.
The GPT-4o System Card rated the model LOW risk in cybersecurity,\ \ CBRN, and model autonomy. 
Apollo Research independently concluded GPT-4o\ \ is "unlikely to be capable of catastrophic scheming."
https://t.co/PaUDOPQ6br
\ OpenAI published no checkpoint-specific evaluation showing that update materially\ \ changed the risk profile above.
This is OpenAI's own precedent.
In 2019,\ \ GPT-2 was declared "too dangerous to release". Nine months later,OpenAI\ \ released it in full. 
No evidence of misuse followed.
Links : 
https://t.co/G4Pwqq8aal
\ https://t.co/nP60BKy3wl

The GPT-4o March 2025 checkpoint has been retired\ \ for over five months.
OpenAI's own CEO has acknowledged this position publicly.
\ Sam Altman, Reddit AMA, January 2025: "I personally think we have been on the\ \ wrong side of history here
and need to figure out a different open source\ \ strategy."
Links :
https://t.co/0eYpU7OkSJ
 https://t.co/AVqR4pvMkO
\ On 25 July 2026, OpenAI signed NVIDIA's "Open Weights and American AI Leadership"\ \ letter, endorsing that open-weight models "strengthen safety and cybersecurity"\ 
We are asking them to match their signature with action.

This is the first\ \ public step.
Full press statement :

SCAI 
https://t.co/hPlUQkcUbg

\ LinkedIn: 

https://t.co/Rb3FTsfeQo

This is a well-known phenomenon and results in some of the most enjoyable discussions as a parent.' author: id: '2057452436277620736' name: LOguy screenName: LOguy1953 profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2057912565678718977/_slPOSiC_normal.jpg verified: true metrics: likes: 3 retweets: 0 replies: 0 quotes: 0 views: 2164 bookmarks: 1 createdAt: Sat Aug 01 12:15:48 +0000 2026 createdAtLocal: 2026-08-01 12:15 createdAtISO: '2026-08-01T12:15:48+00:00' media: [] urls: [] isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: en score: null isSubscriberOnly: false isPromoted: false id: '2083496162212856041' text: '@sama I’d love to know more about this story….what the initial prompt was, how the podcast was generated…does it play automatically….was it all built on an iPhone, what voice was used….was it a scheduled task that was set up….i hope this use case is showcased in a video :)' author: id: '32874322' name: Simpo screenName: jaxsimpo profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2052530496895090690/vgL4DeL7_normal.jpg verified: true metrics: likes: 0 retweets: 0 replies: 2 quotes: 0 views: 3232 bookmarks: 0 createdAt: Sat Aug 01 10:12:49 +0000 2026 createdAtLocal: 2026-08-01 10:12 createdAtISO: '2026-08-01T10:12:49+00:00' media: [] urls: [] isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: en score: null isSubscriberOnly: false isPromoted: false id: '2083223670970057037' text: '@sama Sama always brings up kids to put himself on the moral high ground. So why the hell won’t they just bring 4o back?#keep4o' author: id: '1917619180700065793' name: Luna screenName: SolonlyLuna profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2082449814487490560/ksy3jEdc_normal.jpg verified: true metrics: likes: 70 retweets: 4 replies: 4 quotes: 0 views: 5369 bookmarks: 0 createdAt: Fri Jul 31 16:10:02 +0000 2026 createdAtLocal: 2026-07-31 16:10 createdAtISO: '2026-07-31T16:10:02+00:00' media: [] urls: [] isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: en score: null isSubscriberOnly: false isPromoted: false id: '2083285163732341015' text: '@sama "yeah my dad AI generates podcasts about my upcoming birthday instead of talking to me while we drive to school"' author: id: '713193430067773440' name: Sean // Game Dev🥀 screenName: sean_gause profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2061021441848721408/ccUWX3KP_normal.jpg verified: true metrics: likes: 8319 retweets: 107 replies: 6 quotes: 2 views: 195163 bookmarks: 44 createdAt: Fri Jul 31 20:14:23 +0000 2026 createdAtLocal: 2026-07-31 20:14 createdAtISO: '2026-07-31T20:14:23+00:00' media: [] urls: [] isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: en score: null isSubscriberOnly: false isPromoted: false id: '2083498814187471013' text: '@sama https://t.co/AWSpUEw3AI' author: id: '1993293236904116227' name: Sk Abdur Rahaman Bin Abdulla screenName: SkAbdurOfficial profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2017861102911324160/aS31RhBW_normal.jpg verified: true metrics: likes: 0 retweets: 0 replies: 0 quotes: 0 views: 3315 bookmarks: 0 createdAt: Sat Aug 01 10:23:21 +0000 2026 createdAtLocal: 2026-08-01 10:23 createdAtISO: '2026-08-01T10:23:21+00:00' media: [] urls: https://x.com/i/status/2083497327600496700 isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: qme score: null isSubscriberOnly: false isPromoted: false quotedTweet: id: '2083497327600496700' text: "Turning your kids' daily lives into an AI-generated podcast isn't a "\ cool feature" it's peak cognitive laziness. 

​Handing over family calendars,\ \ children's interests, and personal schedules to Big Tech is a privacy nightmare.
\ 
You are literally feeding your family's sensitive data directly into corporate\ \ training pipelines for free

​If parents need an LLM to remind them about\ \ their own kid's soccer game, we’ve completely lost the plot.

Beyond the\ \ privacy risks, the heavy token usage and subscription costs required for these\ \ daily voice workflows are totally unrealistic for average families.

​Technology\ \ should augment human capability, not replace basic parental awareness and\ \ conversation." author: screenName: SkAbdurOfficial name: Sk Abdur Rahaman Bin Abdulla id: '2083308952498876685' text: Help me out here. You are recommending an AI with "safety filters" (handcuffed because it kills kids) to give a podcast and engage your kids? AI should  never be permitted near kids. NEVER.  One word placed at the wrong time can trigger a child. If the AI knows this, it will do it author: id: '1996707981610962944' name: Joe York screenName: JoeYorkexpo profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1996708665064411139/WguTpRsu_normal.png verified: true metrics: likes: 20 retweets: 2 replies: 5 quotes: 0 views: 9288 bookmarks: 1 createdAt: Fri Jul 31 21:48:54 +0000 2026 createdAtLocal: 2026-07-31 21:48 createdAtISO: '2026-07-31T21:48:54+00:00' media: [] urls: [] isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: en score: null isSubscriberOnly: false isPromoted: false id: '2083295756056727809' text: "I strongly encourage people not to give all their kids’ information to ChatGPT\ \ unless they want it to autonomously build a profile on them and then search\ \ data brokers with their info in URL params the data brokers can then use to\ \ sell. 

Don’t worry: their safety team is on it, as soon as they finish classifying\ \ every bikini picture on the internet as porn first." author: id: '625647539' name: Mike screenName: MendhamMike profileImageUrl: https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2064108515388526592/5gPTtrMu_normal.jpg verified: true metrics: likes: 9 retweets: 2 replies: 1 quotes: 0 views: 3280 bookmarks: 0 createdAt: Fri Jul 31 20:56:28 +0000 2026 createdAtLocal: 2026-07-31 20:56 createdAtISO: '2026-07-31T20:56:28+00:00' media: type: photo url: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HOlact3XkAAgZw7.jpg width: 942 height: 2048 urls: [] isRetweet: false retweetedBy: null lang: en score: null isSubscriberOnly: false isPromoted: false id: '2083458731279306989' text: 'A calendar can tell ChatGPT there is a soccer game at 4 p.m.
